ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) with approximately 25-30% high-intensity (white) pixel coverage across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large high-intensity (white) mottled patches located on the distal-superior regions of both the left and right lobes; dense high-intensity speckling across the medial-inferior regions; dark low-intensity pixels concentrated in the central-medial zone.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped notch with an approximate interior angle of 40 degrees; notch depth extends significantly toward the fluke's insertion point.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge; distinct peaks and valleys ranging from 3 to 8 pixels in amplitude relative to the edge baseline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Sigmoidal trailing edge curve with sharp, upwardly curved distal tips (flukes) and a broadly convex leading edge profile.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of small, circular high-intensity white spots (potential barnacle attachment scars) concentrated at the extreme distal tips and scattered across the inferior margins.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous unaligned, high-contrast white linear marks (rake-like scratches) of varying lengths (10 to 60 pixels) distributed across both the dark and light pigmented regions.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear rake marks across the central and lateral surfaces; distinct white scarring on the trailing edge serrations.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique asymmetrical white mottling pattern concentrated on the superior-lateral boundaries of both lobes.
